title: My sheep hear my voice — hearing shows what a sheep already was (Ezekiel 34; John 10; John 8; Jeremiah 31; Revelation 13)
summary:
It ain't new. The shepherd who says his sheep hear his voice is the shepherd Ezekiel heard say he would go and find them himself:

*For thus saith Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); Behold, I, even I, will both search my sheep, and seek them out.* (Ezekiel 34:11)

*As a shepherd seeketh out his flock in the day that he is among his sheep that are scattered; so will I seek out my sheep, and will deliver them out of all places where they have been scattered in the cloudy and dark day.* (Ezekiel 34:12)

Then the sentence the pulpit has to turn around to keep its gospel:

*But ye believe not, because ye are not of my sheep, as I said unto you.* (John 10:26)

*My sheep hear my voice, and I know them, and they follow me:* (John 10:27)

*And I give unto them eternal life; and they shall never perish, neither shall any man pluck them out of my hand.* (John 10:28)

*My Father, which gave them me, is greater than all; and no man is able to pluck them out of my Father’s hand.* (John 10:29)

Read the order. He does not say they are not his sheep because they do not believe. He says they do not believe because they are not his sheep. The pulpit preaches that believing makes a sheep. The shepherd says a sheep hears, and the hearing shows what it was. He says the same thing in the same gospel more than once:

*He that is of Elohim (God) heareth Elohim's (God’s) words: ye therefore hear them not, because ye are not of Elohim (God).* (John 8:47)

*And he said, Therefore said I unto you, that no man can come unto me, except it were given unto him of my Father.* (John 6:65)

*He answered and said unto them, Because it is given unto you to know the mysteries of the kingdom of heaven, but to them it is not given.* (Matthew 13:11)

The Father gave them, and the giving is old:

*Yahuah (LORD) hath appeared of old unto me, saying, Yea, I have loved thee with an everlasting love: therefore with lovingkindness have I drawn thee.* (Jeremiah 31:3)

*For whom he did foreknow, he also did predestinate to be conformed to the image of his Son, that he might be the firstborn among many brethren.* (Romans 8:29)

*And all that dwell upon the earth shall worship him, whose names are not written in the book of life of the Lamb slain from the foundation of the world.* (Revelation 13:8)

The names were written before the world was laid. The hearing comes in time and shows which names are there. So when Yahusha (Jesus) says to a woman in a house, or to a blind man on the road, that her faith or his faith has saved them, the faith is a sheep hearing:

*And he said to the woman, Thy faith hath saved thee; go in peace.* (Luke 7:50)

*And Yahusha (Jesus) said unto him, Receive thy sight: thy faith hath saved thee.* (Luke 18:42)

And the other sheep are not another kind:

*And other sheep I have, which are not of this fold: them also I must bring, and they shall hear my voice; and there shall be one fold, and one shepherd.* (John 10:16)

Those are the scattered of the house, out in the places Ezekiel named, and they will hear because they are his. This is why the good news is told everywhere and chased nowhere. The word goes out wherever the Father sends it, the sheep in the crowd hear, and the ones who will not hear are left where they stand:

*And whosoever shall not receive you, nor hear your words, when ye depart out of that house or city, shake off the dust of your feet.* (Matthew 10:14)

*Give not that which is holy unto the dogs, neither cast ye your pearls before swine, lest they trample them under their feet, and turn again and rend you.* (Matthew 7:6)

The shepherd goes after the one that is lost because it is his:

*What man of you, having an hundred sheep, if he lose one of them, doth not leave the ninety and nine in the wilderness, and go after that which is lost, until he find it?* (Luke 15:4)

He does not go after what was never his. Hearing does not make a sheep. It finds one.

5383.prose: Believing and being baptized is how the saved are seen, not how they are made. Yahusha (Jesus) says what the believing is: a sheep hearing and following. He says *I know them* in the same breath, so the knowing comes first. The one who believes not is the one who was never his sheep.
5383.phrase: My sheep hear my voice, and I know them, and they follow me
5383.sentence: The sheep hear because they are known, so the believing in Mark shows a sheep and does not make one.

5384.prose: Mark says the one who believes is saved. Paul says who he was before he believed: *foreknow*. Elohim (God) knew them ahead and set them to be like his Son, who is firstborn of many brethren. The believing is the sheep showing what was already settled.
5384.phrase: For whom he did foreknow, he also did predestinate
5384.sentence: Being known ahead comes first, and the believing that follows only shows who was known.

5385.prose: Peter writes to the strangers scattered through Pontus and the rest, and he calls them chosen before they did a thing. Believing and baptism come after a choice already held in the Father's knowledge. The scattered are the elect, and their obeying shows it.
5385.phrase: Elect according to the foreknowledge of Elohim (God) the Father
5385.sentence: The scattered are chosen by the Father's foreknowledge, so their believing shows a choice already made.

5386.prose: The ones who do not believe are the ones whose names were never written. John sees the book kept *from the foundation of the world*. Believing does not write a name in it. The names stood there before anyone was born, and the hearing only brings them to light.
5386.phrase: whose names are not written in the book of life of the Lamb slain from the foundation of the world
5386.sentence: Names are written or not written from before the world, so hearing shows which names were there.

7013.prose: She came to his feet in a house and heard him, and he tells her it was her faith that saved her. Her faith was a sheep hearing its shepherd. He knew her, and she followed. The faith did not make her his. It showed she was.
7013.phrase: My sheep hear my voice, and I know them, and they follow me
7013.sentence: Her faith is the hearing of a sheep that was already known, so it shows what she was.

7016.prose: Good ground bore fruit a hundredfold, and he cries out for ears to hear. The ground was good before the seed fell. The sheep hear his voice because they are his, and what they bear shows what they were all along.
7016.phrase: My sheep hear my voice, and I know them
7016.sentence: The ears that hear are the sheep he knows, so the hearing shows them and does not make them.

7020.prose: He calls her *Daughter* before he says a word about healing. She is his own, one of the scattered of the house of Yashar'el (Israel). Her faith that reached for him was her hearing, and his knowing her stands first in his words: *I know them*.
7020.phrase: My sheep hear my voice, and I know them, and they follow me
7020.sentence: He names her his own, and her faith is the hearing of a sheep he already knew.

7032.prose: A man says he will follow wherever Yahusha (Jesus) goes. Saying it is not the following he means. The sheep follow because they hear and are known. A man's promise to follow does not make a sheep, and the shepherd does not take it for one.
7032.phrase: My sheep hear my voice, and I know them, and they follow me
7032.sentence: The following he names comes from hearing and being known, not from a man's promise to follow.

7040.prose: A woman calls the womb that bore him blessed. Praising where he came from is not hearing his voice. He turns it to the ones who hear. The sheep are the ones who hear and are known, and the blessing is theirs.
7040.phrase: My sheep hear my voice, and I know them
7040.sentence: The blessing is for the ones who hear him and are known, not for praising where he came from.

7060.prose: A man leaves the ninety and nine to go after the one that is lost, because it is his. The sheep was a sheep before it wandered and still a sheep while lost. He finds it because it is his own. Hearing does not make a sheep. It finds one.
7060.phrase: My sheep hear my voice, and I know them, and they follow me
7060.sentence: The lost sheep is found because it was his all along, which is the order of knowing before following.

7073.prose: One of ten comes back, and Yahusha (Jesus) tells him to rise and go, because his faith has made him whole. The coming back is a sheep hearing the voice and following it. The faith shows whose he was. It does not make him so.
7073.phrase: My sheep hear my voice, and I know them, and they follow me
7073.sentence: His coming back is the following of a sheep that hears, so the faith shows whose he was.

7086.prose: The blind man cried out to him on the road, and Yahusha (Jesus) says his faith has saved him. He could not see the shepherd, but he heard him and called. That is a sheep hearing. He knew the voice, and the faith shows it was his to know.
7086.phrase: My sheep hear my voice, and I know them, and they follow me
7086.sentence: A blind man knowing the voice is a sheep hearing its shepherd, and the faith shows what he was.

8076.prose: All the Father gives will come, and none who comes is cast out. Jeremiah says whose work it is: the one who scattered Yashar'el (Israel) gathers him and keeps him as a shepherd. The word is told in the isles afar off, and the ones who come are the ones he scattered.
8076.phrase: He that scattered Yashar'el (Israel) will gather him, and keep him, as a shepherd doth his flock
8076.sentence: The gathering is the work of the one who scattered, so those who come are the ones the Father gives.

8075.prose: No one comes unless the Father draws him, and Hosea shows the drawing is old. Yahuah (LORD) drew Ephraim with cords and *bands of love* before they knew it. The coming in time is the drawing seen, not the drawing begun.
8075.phrase: I drew them with cords of a man, with bands of love
8075.sentence: The drawing comes first and is the Father's, so the coming only shows it.

8074.prose: No one comes unless it is given him of the Father, and Ezekiel says what is given: *a new heart*, the stony one taken out and one of flesh put in. He says it to the house gathered out of all countries into their own land. The giving is his, and the hearing follows it.
8074.phrase: A new heart also will I give you, and a new spirit will I put within you
8074.sentence: What lets a sheep come is given by the Father to the gathered house, before any hearing.

8081.prose: He says they do not believe because they are not his sheep, and John sees the same order in the book. Names are written or not written *from the foundation of the world*. Not believing took no name out. The names were there or not there from the start.
8081.phrase: whose names are not written in the book of life of the Lamb slain from the foundation of the world
8081.sentence: The names were settled from the foundation, so not believing shows a name was never written.

8080.prose: The sheep hear because they are known, and Jeremiah says how long they have been known. Yahuah (LORD) appeared of old and said it was *an everlasting love* that drew Yashar'el (Israel). The following in time answers a love that was there before.
8080.phrase: I have loved thee with an everlasting love: therefore with lovingkindness have I drawn thee
8080.sentence: The drawing by an everlasting love comes before the hearing, so the following answers an old love.

8079.prose: The voice the sheep hear belongs to the shepherd Ezekiel heard say he would search for them himself. He does not send word and wait for the flock to find him. He seeks them out, scattered as they are, and they know the voice because they are his.
8079.phrase: Behold, I, even I, will both search my sheep, and seek them out
8079.sentence: The shepherd who calls is the one who goes out and finds his own scattered sheep himself.

8073.prose: Why do some hear and some do not? He answers that it is *given*. The hearing is not earned and not chosen into. It is given to the ones who are his, and to the others it is not given. This is the sheep hearing his voice, said another way.
8073.phrase: Because it is given unto you to know the mysteries of the kingdom of heaven
8073.sentence: Hearing the mysteries is given to some and not to others, so hearing shows who was given.

8078.prose: No one plucks them out of his hand, and Isaiah gives the reason. Zion said she was forgotten, and he answers that a mother may forget but he will not. The hand that holds them is the hand that does not forget, so they are kept.
8078.phrase: yea, they may forget, yet will I not forget thee
8078.sentence: The one who will not forget Zion is the one whose hand keeps the sheep safe.

8077.prose: The Father gave them, and Moses says why anyone is given. It was not for numbers or worth. Yahuah (LORD) set his love on the *fewest of all people* and kept the oath to their fathers. The giving was never earned by hearing. The hearing comes because the gift was made.
8077.phrase: Yahuah (LORD) did not set his love upon you, nor choose you, because ye were more in number than any people
8077.sentence: The people were chosen by love and not by merit, which is the ground of the Father giving them.

8072.prose: He prays for the ones given him and does not pray for the world. John saw the same line drawn in the book: names written, and names *not written* from the foundation. Those who wonder after the beast are outside it. The ones he prays for were his before he asked.
8072.phrase: whose names were not written in the book of life from the foundation of the world
8072.sentence: The same two groups stand in the book from the foundation: those given to him, and those whose names were not written.

fable_read: Claude Fable 5.1 read every card (22): 8075 bare Yahuah given its parenthetical; the scattered strangers of 1 Peter 1 read as the elect of the house; no theological corrections.
